title: ASE A7 Certification Practice Test
content:
ASE A7 Heating Air Conditioning Practice Test
26. Technician A says while performing a retrofit from R-12 refrigerant to R134a refrigerant, the refrigerant must be recovered into a dedicated cylinder and not mixed. Technician B says R-12 refrigerant functions at higher pressures than R-134a refrigerant does. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
27. Technician A says an ambient temperature sensor senses cabin air temperature. Technician B says a faulty ambient temperature sensor can prevent compressor clutch engagement. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
28. During an initial inspection, one line on the receiver drier is cooler than the other. This is caused by:
- A. A refrigerant overcharge.
- B. A low refrigerant charge.
- C. Too much oil in the system.
- D. A restriction in the receiver drier.
29. The electrical symbol in the image above represents:
- A. A thermistor.
- B. A connector.
- C. A diode.
- D. A variable resistor.
30. Two technicians are discussing refrigerant storage. Technician A says HFC-134a is contained in a sky-blue container. Technician B says CFC-12 is contained in a white container. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
